intro: Silver of the Waves involves recovering a tarnished, monogrammed silver hair clip found abandoned among discarded fishing debris. Returning the lost keepsake to its owner brings a welcome reprieve from their daily chores and restores a treasured possession once thought lost to the tide.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D."

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?

clips.title: Completion
paras: My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good!
This'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.
